verdict.rationale: Vercel's site claims it can 'secure every internal agent, app, and deployment with your identity provider' (vercel-docs-13), which matches the story directly. Separately, its docs describe Deployment Protection that controls who can open preview and production URLs via Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs (vercel-docs-26). However, the identity-provider claim is a single marketing line, and the documented access controls never mention an external IdP. Missing for 10: documented SSO/SAML/OIDC integration details, supported IdP list, how agents specifically are secured, plan/tier availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
